stories.fallback: Cleveland finished the job, 9–5. The elimination game became an invitation to Game 5. Sometimes the whole shape of a postseason changes in one half-inning.
stories.summary: Six runs in one half-inning kept Cleveland alive. Two synchronized score lines · 7 seconds.
stories.title: The Sixth That Saved October

stories.fallback: No lead grew beyond two runs. Milwaukee won Games 1, 2 and 4, and took the series 3–1. Four games of having just enough—and almost no cushion.
stories.summary: Four games without a lead bigger than two. Four sequential margin lines · 8 seconds.
stories.title: Four Games. Never Breathing Room.

stories.fallback: Then he closed all three ALDS wins.
stories.summary: A career went from four saves to forty-one. Six annual bars · 6 seconds.
stories.title: Four Saves. Then Forty-One.
